title: 786. Rotated Digits

examples.explanation: Nine values up to 20 change under rotation.

hints: Check each number digit by digit: reject on 3, 4, or 7, and require at least one of 2, 5, 6, 9.
A lookup table for the ten digits keeps the inner test tiny.
With n capped at 10000, a straight scan from 1 to n is fast enough.
